title: Air Navigation — Chapter 113 (Replacement)
text:
LAWS OF BRUNEI
Air Navigation CAP. 113 1
The Air Navigation Act (Chapter 113) was repealed* by
the Civil Aviation Order, 2006 (S 63/2006)
with effect from 20th May 2006
* The subsidiary legislation made under the Air Navigation Act was saved by section 53(3) of the Civil Aviation
Order, 2006
B.L.R.O. 1/2016
